units.source_text: 雨点敲打在杉树末梢上，沙沙作响。

en.t: Raindrops beat against the tips of the cedars with a rustling sound.

units.source_text: 每次闪电，一道亮光直闪到地上，把两个姑娘周围的杉树树干都照亮了。

en.t: Each time lightning flashed, a bright streak shot straight down to the ground, lighting up all the cedar trunks around the two girls.

units.source_text: 转眼间，美丽笔直的树干也变得令人望而生畏。

en.t: In an instant, even the beautiful, straight trunks became frightening to behold.

units.source_text: 不容思索，马上又是一阵雷鸣。

en.t: Before there was time to think, another peal of thunder came at once.
